title: Gyidifo a Wahintaw no
intro: Wɔ tumidi asa ahorow a ɛyɛ fɛ, baabi a gyidi a wonni ne atirimɔdensɛm dii hene no, nokware nne bi a ɛyɛ ankonam fi baabi a na wɔnhwɛ kwan kasae. Saa dodow yi twaa tumi a wɔde bɔ ɔbɔfo bi ho ban no mpoa, na wɔde wɔn ankasa ahobammɔ too asiane mu de bɔɔ nokware no ho dawuru.
clues: Na mete asase a atirimɔdensɛm kɛse wom so, na mesom sodifo bi a ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onyame.
Mede me gyidi ankasa siei mfe pii, na na misuro nea ebefi mu aba bere a mada no adi no.
Bere a ɔbɔfo bi de nsɛnkyerɛnne a emu da hɔ bae no, migye dii, nanso me nkurɔfo bɔɔ pɔw tiaa no.
Migyinaa otirimɔdenfo no ne n’agyinatukuw no anim, gyee akyinnye sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wokum ɔbɔfo a ne ho nni asɛm.
Mebɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ wɔ asotwe a aman a atwam a wɔpoo nokware no, te sɛ Noa ne ‘Ad’ nkurɔfo no ho.
Allah gyee me firii wɔn pɔw bɔne no mu, na mehunuu sɛ wɔresɛe nnisoɔ a ɛhyɛ nkurɔfoɔ so no.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Odiyifo bi a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi kum ho
Abantenten a wɔresi na ama wɔadu soro
Po no mu a wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu de aguan
Ɔhene bi dae a wɔkyerɛ ase
trial.answer: Odiyifo bi a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi kum ho

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wogyee no fii ɔhaw mu bere a wɔsɛee nhyɛsofo no
Wɔtow no guu ogya mu na ofii adi a hwee anyɛ no
outcome.answer: Wogyee no fii ɔhaw mu bere a wɔsɛee nhyɛsofo no

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
